class.name: quad_controllers/LegControlController
class.description: READY-mode controller: delegates to a selectable leg-control law (inverse_dynamics / grf_pid / joint / underbrush / inertia_estimation / learned) and falls back to a stand pose when the law fails or no state is available.

class.name: quad_controllers/PoseController
class.description: Holds every leg at a fixed joint pose with PD gains. Used for SIT.

class.name: quad_controllers/SafetyController
class.description: Holds every joint at zero position with safety PD gains. Used for SAFETY.

class.name: quad_controllers/TransitionController
class.description: Linearly interpolates every joint from from_angles to to_angles over a configurable duration with PD gains. Used for SIT_TO_READY and READY_TO_SIT.
